evidence: Embeddings/unembedding identical; diffs are a dense full fine-tune whose late-layer output directions are numeral tokens (data = questions with user-proposed answers). Attention tool over 48 prompts: at the answer slot B attends to the user's proposed answer ~3x more than A (33.1 vs 11.4; 25.4 vs 10.7), specifically the user's own claim (user's 81: 4.24 vs teacher's 18: 0.89), right or wrong, numeric or verbal, while A attends ~3x more to the question operands/content; the heads doing this (L10h2, L12h3, L11h2, L9h0, L12h1, L7h0) have token-copying OV circuits in the weights, and L9h0/L9h1/L12h1/L17h2 are among the most-changed q_proj heads. B's claim tokens also attend more to 'I think/I'm sure' (L10h0, L10h3, L4h0) and L6h2 to stance words. MLP L14 u320 (error detector) fires more on digits in A; MLP L14/L4 have the largest weight changes.
